messages:
ana: Heads-up — product flagged a bug: users saw canary behavior even after feature flag off. Anyone seen similar?
jay: Hmm, do we have precedence rules for feature flags vs rollout policies? I thought flags override, but maybe rollout guard kicked in.
sam: We currently implement three layers: global rollout policy, route-level rollout policy, and app feature flags. Precedence has been messy.
li: I just ran a quick trace. Deploy bot logs show policy fallback to canary variant because the route policy had strict guard: `allow_canary: true`.
maria: that sounds like we let route policies mutate traffic after feature flag evaluation? That seems backwards.
ana: (typo) ana: @sam can you paste the code path? small snippet would help.
sam: Sure — simplified logic today:
```
if route_policy.exists:
    apply route_policy
elif global_policy.exists:
    apply global_policy
else:
    apply feature_flag
```
So flags are last.
jay: Oof. So platform-owned policies win over app flags. That's the confusion.
li: My vote: feature flags (app) should be evaluated before routing policies. Platform policies should act as guards not silent overrides.
maria: Agreed. Guards should be able to block rollout (pct limits, rollout windows) but not flip a feature on for users who opted out.
sam: Two options:
- invert order so flags decide experiment bucket then policies can veto (block/limit)
- keep order but add explicit `respect_flag: true` on route policy
Which is less disruptive?
ana: ana: I like the `respect_flag` flag — least breaking. But defaults should change long-term.
jay: UX: Console needs to show effective decision tree. Right now you can't tell why a user hit variant A.
li: +1. Proposed console view: selected flag state, route_policy applied, final decision, and which entity owns each layer.
maria: Also need audit logs showing owner and change reason. Product teams will demand that.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: automated test run: rollout-policy-e2e passed on canary. logs: /ci/rollouts/1760854310
sam: Action items:
- sam: sketch PR to add `respect_flag` + tests (ETA 3d)
- jay: mockups for console effective-config view (ETA 5d)
- li: add audit fields to policy schema (owner, contact) (ETA 4d)
ana: ana: i'll notify product teams and add to next retro. :calendar:
maria: thanks everyone. let's avoid surprising product next time. :thumbsup:
